## How I help

I'll come to your home or business in Fruita, meet you at a coffee shop or the library, or help by phone or screen share.
Pricing is flexible: I have a typical hourly rate, a bit higher for businesses, but if money's tight we'll work something out, trades included.

::: {.ftw-not}
**Not my thing:** cracked screens and most hardware repair, running network cable, or installing security cameras.
I'm happy to point you to someone who does those.
:::
